title: Tokens-per-Parameter Coverage Is Critical for Robust LLM Scaling Law Extrapolation
abstract: arXiv:2605.08541v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural scaling laws approximate a language model's loss as a power-law function of parameter count $N$ and token count $D$. Following Chinchilla-style compute-optimal training, many studies fit scaling laws from runs performed under a fixed tokens-per-parameter (TPP) ratio $k$ and set $D = kN$. We show that this collinear design, combined with the empirically common near-equality of the exponents governing $N$ and $D$, induces an inherent ill-conditioning in the Gauss-Newton least-squares problem: the condition number of the design grows as the inverse square of the gap between the $N$ and $D$-exponents. The scale coefficients become practically unidentifiable, with confidence intervals inflating by an order of magnitude or more, yielding a ``sloppy'' model whose extrapolations degrade sharply off the training ray. translated_title: 每参数Token覆盖度对稳健的LLM缩放定律外推至关重要
translated_abstract: 神经缩放定律将语言模型的损失近似为参数量 $N$ 和Token数 $D$ 的幂律函数。遵循Chinchilla式的计算最优训练范式，许多研究在固定的每参数Token比例（TPP）$k$ 下进行实验来拟合缩放定律，并令 $D = kN$。我们证明，这种共线设计，结合经验上常见的 $N$ 与 $D$ 指数近似相等的现象，会在高斯-牛顿最小二乘问题中引入固有的病态性：设计矩阵的条件数随 $N$ 与 $D$ 指数之间差距的平方倒数增长。尺度系数实际上变得不可辨识，其置信区间膨胀一个数量级甚至更多，产生一个“松散”的模型，其外推能力在偏离训练射线时急剧退化。我们针对四种缩放定律形式证明了这一点，并推导出一个封闭形式的TPP多样性阈值，该阈值是必要且充分的……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文证明在固定每参数Token比例下拟合LLM缩放定律会因N与D指数近似相等导致的共线性而使最小二乘问题病态化、尺度系数不可辨识，并推导出实现稳健外推所需的TPP多样性闭式阈值。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that fitting LLM scaling laws under a fixed tokens-per-parameter ratio induces ill-conditioning due to near-equal N and D exponents, making scale coefficients unidentifiable, and derives a closed-form TPP-diversity threshold necessary and sufficient for robust extrapolation.
